art_direction: 可可小狗 · 温柔: 淡灰白底，可可棕垂耳与白色短脸，温柔侧望。
composition_variation: A small beautifully designed floppy-eared puppy portrait on a clean pale gray-white field. Soft white short rounded face, cocoa-brown ears hanging at both sides with one ear a little higher; an asymmetric small brown patch around one eye. Two gentle black oval eyes with tiny white highlights looking slightly upward. Little rounded black nose and a tiny curved mouth. Friendly calm intelligent mood, not a silly panting face. Ear and cheek curves soft and clean, no fur texture. Head fills about 62 percent of square width with lots of clean space. Three colors: background off-white, cocoa brown, black. No collar, tongue, body or paw.
style_inspiration: Broad style cues from the two chat examples: minimalist flat color, expressive small faces, sparse palette and generous negative space. Subjects and compositions are original and different. No attachment was uploaded as binary model input.
